regression.before: New mailbox messages incorrectly reached updated/deleted-only subscriptions; real HTTP assertion observed /mail and /updated instead of /mail only.
regression.after: Creation delivery filters subscription changeType as well as resource and expiry.

replay: Existing message identity is reused across two callback deliveries; the mailbox still contains exactly one message.
Real HTTP202 succeeds;503 and302 fail without following the redirect.
Connection reset reports status:null and an error while preserving the message.
limitations: Protocol checks use a loopback callback receiver; mailbox browser and application processing acceptance remain outstanding.
The single-mailbox emulator does not prove cross-mailbox or delegated permission parity.
Native CI requires publishing the local checkpoint.
